newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June coffee exports 998,850 bags - Febec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June coffee exports 998,850 bags - Febec.

text.p: Brazil exported 998,850 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in June, down from an adjusted May figure of 1.42 million bags, said Federation of Coffee Exporters (Febec).
Previously, Febec estimated May exports at 1.33 million bags.
The June total is, however, above the 750,954 bags exported in the same month in 1996.
Brazilian exports so far this year are 7.56 million bags, almost exactly twice the 3.76 million bags shipped in first half 1996.
Under an agreement with other producing countries, Brazil was not to ship more than six million bags in the first six months of this calendar year.
The six month quota was part of an overall Brazilian export allowance of 15 million bags in 1996/97 (July/June).
Brazil last month told the Association of Coffee Producing Countries that it was likely to exceed the 15-million bag export quota by 1.2 million bags or eight percent.
According to Febec statistics, total exports in July to June were 16.54 million bags.
The June 1997 sales brought total earnings from coffee exports so far this year to $1.38 billion, 247 percent higher than the $556.78 million earned in the same period in 1996.
Revenue last month was $217.49 million against $109.88 million in June last year and $296.30 million in May 1997.
The average price per bag rose to $217.74 in June compared with $209.37 in May, Febec said.
Of June's total, 898,645 bags were arabica coffee, while shipments of conillon reached 100,205 bags.
